title: AetherisRouteEvidence
description: NON-AUTHORITATIVE OxDeAI audit artifact (issue #122 review surface). Audit metadata only — MUST NOT be read by AuthorizationV1, PEP, or policy engines. Integer-only wire: confidence_bps and cost_estimate_millicents align with adapters/utils.py encoding shared by thymos_adapter.py; route labels here use capability-centric selected + normalized alternatives (NOT OpenThymos provider:capability labels). Locked reference hash: 306b3c59d4eb15efac1f31cb3dda6454538e442f423a366d950b7008946debaa — see docs/compliance/oxdeai_spec.md §3.

decision_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical preimage per oxdeai_spec.md §3 (oxdeai_v1). Locked reference vector hash: 306b3c59d4eb15efac1f31cb3dda6454538e442f423a366d950b7008946debaa. Audit output — never an authorization input.

routing_decision_id.description: Optional WisePick /v1/decide decision_id. When present, serialized in the decision_hash preimage under the legacy key decision_id (not routing_decision_id).

selected.description: Normalized winning capability_id (strip + lower). OxDeAI wire — not the OpenThymos provider:capability route label.

alternatives.description: Ranked non-primary labels from trace.top_candidates (normalized capability_id or provider token). OxDeAI wire — not provider:capability.

confidence_bps.description: Routing confidence in basis points (0–10000). Same integer encoding as thymos_adapter.RoutingEvidence.confidence_bps via confidence_to_basis_points().

reason_codes.description: Structured routing rationale. Sorted lexicographically inside the decision_hash preimage.

latency_estimate_ms.description: Non-binding latency estimate in milliseconds. Same field name as thymos_adapter; excluded from OxDeAI decision_hash preimage.

cost_estimate_millicents.description: Non-binding cost in USD millicents (1 USD = 100_000). Same field name and encoding as thymos_adapter via usd_to_millicents(); excluded from OxDeAI decision_hash preimage.
